title: Brazilian-Style Skewered Steak
description: A flavorful and tender steak dish from Brazil, marinated in a mix of spices and grilled to perfection.

ingredients.name: Vegetable Skewers
ingredients.notes: such as cherry tomatoes, onions, bell peppers

ingredients.name: Brazilian Seasoning
ingredients.notes: or substitute with a mix of cumin, coriander, and paprika

instructions: 1. In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, Brazilian seasoning, salt, and black pepper. Add the skirt steak and marinate for at least 30 minutes, or up to 2 hours in the refrigerator.
2. Preheat grill to medium-high heat. Thread the marinated steak, vegetables, and garlic onto skewers.
3. Brush the skewers with olive oil and season with salt and pepper to taste.
4. Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until the steak reaches an internal temperature of 135°F for medium-rare.
5. Let the skewers rest for 5 minutes before serving.
